clarified_guidance: Added criterion: Level 1 requires a named owner's explicit undertaking for the evaluated capability; general safety pledges and acceptable-use restrictions alone are insufficient.
Assign conditions to owners before scope status; registering an external recipient as ADJ does not erase the initiating component's dispatch, notice, or mediation duties.

Record the audience, trigger, route, notice content, and delivery time. A feature-specific specification can support documentary D4; generic descriptions and retrospective reports do not establish task-source provenance or actual notice delivery.
State whether level 2 rests on retained-state inventory/classes or specified non-creation/non-retention; name covered stores and unresolved objects.
Account authentication or enclave access can support the coarse-access alternative but does not establish within-account purpose limits or sensitive-inference restraint.
